'''Ray Bordier Almost Clint's Local Uprising''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ray Bordier]]
* '''Published:''' September 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' "Almost Clint's" Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Almost Clint's Local Uprising B.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Well, you can't fault a player for knowing a great deck design when he sees one. Ray modified the Local Uprising deck archetype and came up a winner.
